guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「社區入滲的地層、地下水與事件調蓄」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow stratigraphy, groundwater and event storage for community infiltration through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「集水組成與逕流」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 660 m2，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「土地使用變更而不更新集水資料會低估水量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「入滲量與儲存需求」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 28 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「日入滲能力足夠仍可能在短強雨溢流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「地層調查與最慢層」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 110 h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只做淺表試驗會漏掉深處限制。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「地下水距離與水丘」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.4 m，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用最低季節水位會高估安全間距。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「前處理與堵塞負荷」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 6 kg/event，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「前處理滿載會加速入滲面堵塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「入滲溝空隙容量」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 14 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總挖方當儲水量會放大容量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「污染場址與入滲限制」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 60 day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把雨水乾淨當成地下環境也乾淨會漏掉污染源。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「溢流路線與串聯系統」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 12 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只假設下一座永遠有空間會低估總風險。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「觀測井與退水診斷」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.05 m/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「表面無水就停止觀測可能錯過底層長期飽和。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「多目標維護與居民介面」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只完成清掃而不量退水，無法驗證功能恢復。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for catchment composition and runoff, first reproduce 660 m2, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unupdated land-use changes understate runoff." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for infiltration and storage demand, first reproduce 28 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adequate daily capacity can still overflow in a short intense storm." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for stratigraphy and the limiting layer, first reproduce 110 h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Shallow testing misses deeper constraints." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for groundwater separation and mounding, first reproduce 1.4 m, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using the seasonal minimum overstates separation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pretreatment and clogging load, first reproduce 6 kg/event, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A full pretreatment unit accelerates infiltration-surface clogging." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for trench void storage, first reproduce 14 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using excavation volume exaggerates storage." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for contaminated sites and infiltration limits, first reproduce 60 day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Clean rain does not imply clean subsurface conditions." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for overflow routes and linked systems, first reproduce 12 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Assuming downstream storage is always empty understates risk." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for observation wells and drawdown diagnosis, first reproduce 0.05 m/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Stopping when the surface dries misses persistent lower saturation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for maintenance and community interface, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Cleaning without drawdown measurements cannot verify recovery." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 把100m2草地改成鋪面並重算有效面積。
比較同總雨量的短強雨和長弱雨。
移除或加厚低滲層，比較等效阻力。
比較乾季與濕季地下水位並記錄基準高程。
把前池去除率由0.7降到0.4，估入滲床負荷。
比較相同開挖體積兩種孔隙率。
比較清潔回填與污染層兩種流路。
模擬兩座設施同時滿水，追蹤最後溢流。
以連續水位比較線性、指數與尾端緩慢退水。
把淤積、積水與垃圾各自配對責任人及證據。
evidenceEn: Convert100m2 of lawn to pavement and recalculate effective area.
Compare short intense and long weak storms with equal totals.
Remove or thicken the low-permeability layer and compare resistance.
Compare dry- and wet-season levels with a common datum.
Reduce forebay removal from0.7 to0.4 and estimate bed loading.
Compare two porosities at equal excavation volume.
Compare flow paths through clean fill and a contaminated layer.
Fill two facilities simultaneously and trace final overflow.
Compare linear, exponential and slow-tail drawdown shapes.
Assign owners and evidence separately for sediment, ponding and litter.
pitfalls: 土地使用變更而不更新集水資料會低估水量。
日入滲能力足夠仍可能在短強雨溢流。
只做淺表試驗會漏掉深處限制。
用最低季節水位會高估安全間距。
前處理滿載會加速入滲面堵塞。
把總挖方當儲水量會放大容量。
把雨水乾淨當成地下環境也乾淨會漏掉污染源。
只假設下一座永遠有空間會低估總風險。
表面無水就停止觀測可能錯過底層長期飽和。
只完成清掃而不量退水，無法驗證功能恢復。
pitfallsEn: Adequate daily capacity can still overflow in a short intense storm.
Using the seasonal minimum overstates separation.
A full pretreatment unit accelerates infiltration-surface clogging.
Clean rain does not imply clean subsurface conditions.
Assuming downstream storage is always empty understates risk.
Stopping when the surface dries misses persistent lower saturation.
Cleaning without drawdown measurements cannot verify recovery.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 首爾清溪川復育
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
